subfiles.title: List of Papers on Fueling and Fuel Stations—Japan
subfiles.about: An index summarizes four papers on restricting fuel and other supplies furnished to Japanese vessels in the Americas and Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Lists a British proposal and Welles-Halifax talk on denying Japanese ships fuel in Latin America, plus a Singapore bunkering-limit memo.

interest: Tracks 1941 British-American moves limiting Japanese ship fueling.
